6/23- HIDALGO, TX- Border Patrol agents stopped a dangerous predator from entering the U.S. illegally. Jesus Saavedra-Orozco, a Mexican national and registered sex offender, was sentenced to 18 years in prison for a conviction of aggravated sexual assault of a child. That's not all- Let's take a look at the rest of his criminal history:

🔹Theft
🔹Burglary of Habitation
🔹Possession of a controlled substance

He now faces prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8USC1326). This is why border security isn't an option- it's a necessity. #keepingcriminalsout

tweets.text:
NEARLY $3.5M WORTH OF COCAINE SEIZED!

FALFURRIAS, TX- On June 28th, a U.S. citizen was arrested at the Falfurrias USBP Checkpoint after agents discovered 109 lbs. of cocaine inside his semi-truck. An X-ray inspection detected anomalies in the sleeper area, prompting agents to take a closer look, where they found several wrapped packages of the dangerous drug hidden under the mattress. DEA took custody of the narcotics and the driver, who now faces charges for drug trafficking.

Agent expertise combined with cutting-edge technology is a true force multiplier.

tweets.text:
It just keeps getting better!  USBP apprehensions hit a historic low for the month of June. The numbers don't lie- border security is stronger than ever.
 
June 2025 Highlights: ▪️8,039 total apprehensions- compared to a staggering 11,414 in just the first three days of June last year.  ▪️Lowest single-day apprehensions on record; only 137 on June 28th. ▪️Gotaways PLUNGED by 90% compared to June 2024. ▪️ZERO releases. That's right- no catch-and-release.

6/29- While conducting highway operations near Moss Point, MS, USBP agents intercepted a vehicle carrying a bulk cash load along Interstate 10. A highly trained USBP K-9 quickly alerted to the hidden stash of currency concealed in bags and a backpack- $137,500 in illicit proceeds. The FBI seized the money after the driver denied ownership.

It's been a remarkable year so far- USBP and law enforcement partners have seized a staggering $24,683,535 MILLION in illicit cash. 💥

tweets.text:
7/2- MS-13 Gang Member on the run in Dallas, Texas, was located by USBP agents.
The Salvadoran national attempted to evade agents and ultimately drove himself home. Upon arrival at his home, agents were met with three adult relatives who ambushed and assaulted the agents. With the assistance of FBI and ICE, all subjects successfully exited the residence and USBP agents determined they were ALL illegally present in the country. The Salvadoran national plus two adult females and one adult male will be charged with assaulting a federal agent and put into removal proceedings. BONUS: the17 year old juvenile who punched USBP agents will face state charges for assault on an officer and placed in removal proceedings as well.

We will continue to work with our partners to deliver consequences to ANYONE that assaults our agents.
